market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI ~$102 May 2; needs CME settlement >=$120 by end-June. That's ~18% above current spot, requires settles (not intraday). EIA Q2 Brent peak $115 implies WTI ~$110-115 base case. Hormuz disruption could push higher; analyst upper end $125 in May. Plausible but a stretch with ~2 months and need for sustained rally rather than spike.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Duration and severity of Hormuz/Iran supply shock.
